_comment: Industry credentials shown on the counselor page (and reusable elsewhere). Researched 2026-09-07 from the issuers' pages and current exam guides; costs are the issuers' US list prices at that date and are labelled 'as listed'. `status` + `pairs` read as a sentence ("Built into AI 40"); `pairs` is the course the program builds the credential into or prepares students for: IBM in AI 40 and Microsoft in AI 40 are Vincent's; the rest read "Complements <course>" (Vincent, 2026-09-07: open, public resources students may meet alongside the program; no partnerships implied). `tagline` is the one line on the card's front; `what`, `cost`, `costNote`, `status` and `pairs` are the back. `mark` is the short text shown in the brand tile (no logos: third-party logos need the owner's brand permission and would bring colours outside BRIEF §4). Update `checked` when a row is re-verified.

items.name: IBM SkillsBuild: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
items.what: A guided plan on AI concepts, machine learning, language, vision and ethics, ending in a verified IBM credential for LinkedIn.
items.tagline: Free IBM badge in AI foundations, earned in AI 40.

items.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
items.costNote: free training on Microsoft Learn; US exam fee as listed
items.what: Microsoft's foundational AI exam, refreshed in 2026 as AI-901 (AI-900 retired June 30, 2026) with more generative AI, Copilot and agents. Free Microsoft Learn modules cover it all.
items.tagline: Entry-level Microsoft AI certification: free prep, $99 exam.

items.name: Google AI Essentials and Google Prompting Essentials
items.kind: Certificates (Coursera); free skill badges on Google Skills
items.costNote: Google Skills badges free; Coursera certificates $49 each, free via Google.org for a limited time
items.what: AI Essentials covers using AI tools at work, prompting and responsible use; Prompting Essentials is a short five-step course. Google Skills adds a free Introduction to Generative AI path with badges.
items.tagline: Google's AI at work and prompting courses; badges are free.

items.name: OpenAI Academy courses and certificates
items.kind: Course-completion certificates; formal OpenAI Certification in pilot
items.costNote: free with a ChatGPT account; formal certification in pilot
items.what: Short courses on AI foundations, ChatGPT at work and agent workflows, each with a completion certificate. OpenAI's formal certification is piloting with employers and universities and should widen in 2026.
items.tagline: Free short courses and certificates on ChatGPT and agents.

items.name: Anthropic Academy: AI Fluency and Claude courses
items.kind: Course-completion certificates; paid Claude Certifications for partner organizations
items.costNote: Academy free; proctored Claude Certified exams ($99+) are for Claude Partner Network organizations
items.what: A non-technical AI Fluency series (delegation, description, discernment, diligence) plus builder courses on the Claude API, agents and Model Context Protocol, each with an Anthropic certificate.
items.tagline: Free AI Fluency and Claude builder courses, with certificates.

items.name: AWS Educate: Introduction to Generative AI, and AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.kind: Free training badge; proctored certification exam
items.costNote: AWS Educate and Skill Builder prep free; AIF-C01 exam fee as listed
items.what: AWS Educate issues a free Introduction to Generative AI badge and a path toward the AI Practitioner certification, which covers AI, machine learning and generative AI on AWS.
items.statusNote: beside COSN 250, the degree’s cloud course
items.tagline: Free generative AI badge, and the AI Practitioner exam.
